rulesets.name: Two-step 10 / 5
rulesets.description: Phase 1 +10%, phase 2 +5%. 5% daily loss, 10% max loss from the start balance, no time limit, 4 min days.

rulesets.name: One-step 10 / 6
rulesets.description: Single phase +10%. 3% daily loss, 6% max loss from the start balance, no time limit.

rulesets.name: Two-step, 30-day phases
rulesets.description: Same as the two-step but each phase must be finished within 30 calendar days.

rulesets.name: Futures-style trailing 6 / 4
rulesets.description: Target +6%, 4% trailing drawdown measured from the highest closed balance (e.g. $3k target and $2k trail on $50k).
